Antara Cinta Dan Dusta
programme.desc: Atikah is an innocent, funny, kind, sincere, patient, and hardworking girl. She lives with her grandmother, Mbah Marni, in the village of Wagir Kidul, near Ponorogo, East Java. There, there is a young doctor named Aryo who works as a PTT (non-permanent employee) at a community health center.

programme.title: Sinema Spesial: Jeritan Malam
programme.desc: Reza dan ketiga temannya mencoba menelusuri sejarah asrama tempat mereka tinggal. Namun sayangnya, Reza melakukan ritual yang seharusnya tidak dilakukan.

programme.title: Kaho Naa Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: A young girl meets the doppelganger of her deceased boyfriend and now has a chance to find the people who have murdered him.

programme.title: Bioskop Asia: Black Cat 2
programme.desc: Para ilmuwan memasang sebuah chip mikro, yang disebut Black Cat, di dalam otak seorang gadis yang rentan terhadap kekerasan dalam upaya untuk memperbaiki dan mengendalikan amarahnya.

programme.title: Bioskop Asia: Mercury Man
programme.desc: Setelah terpapar sebuah zat aneh, seorang pemadam kebakaran biasa berubah menjadi Manusia Merkurius. Dikaruniai dengan kekuatan super yang fantastis, dia pun memakai kemampuannya untuk menaklukkan kekuatan jahat.

programme.title: Mega Bollywood: Chak De! India
programme.desc: Kabir Khan, pelatih Tim Hoki Nasional Wanita India, bermimpi membuat tim yang semuanya perempuan tampil sebagai pemenang melawan segala rintangan.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ibunya, Jhanak terpaksa menikahi tunangan sepupunya Arshi, Aniruddh, untuk melarikan diri dari penguntitnya, Tejas. Meskipun Aniruddh dan Arshi telah bersama selama tujuh tahun, Jhanak memasuki kehidupan mereka dalam keadaan yang menyedihkan dan mulai bekerja sebagai pembantu di rumah tangga Bose. Sementara beberapa anggota keluarga memperlakukannya dengan baik, yang lain terus-menerus menghina dan meremehkannya.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha tells the story of Sachin and Sailee, a middle-class couple, as they navigate the complexities of their relationship. The story centers on Sailee’s struggles as she faces resistance from her husband and her efforts to inspire change not only for their own growth but also for the well-being of their entire family.

programme.title: Hati ke Hati Bersama Mamah Dedeh
programme.desc: Perbincangan yang mengupas tuntas tentang permasalahan keluarga dalam kehidupan sehari-hari yang akan dibahas dari pandangan Islam.

programme.title: Aini: Malaikat Tak Bersayap
programme.desc: Aini, seorang gadis yang durhaka kepada ibunya. Perubahan sikap Aini terjadi setelah kehidupan dan pergaulannya yang mewah, berubah 180 derajat. Aini selalu mengacuhkan segala nasihat ibunya dan menjerumuskan diri ke dalam kemaksiatan.

programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: The fate of the three Brar cousins Angad, Garry and Veer are linked with the three Monga sisters Sahiba, Seerat and Keerat. Sahiba is the hardworking and independent second daughter of the Monga family. She is an artist and earns money for her family by selling her art. Seerat, the eldest Monga sister, is pampered by her mother, Santosh, for her beauty. Santosh dreams of getting Seerat married to a rich man. As fate would have it, Angad falls in love with Seerat. However, Seerat is manipulated by Garry and his fake love. On Seerat and Angad's wedding day, Seerat runs away with Garry.

programme.title: Antara Cinta And Dusta
programme.desc: Pitcha, seorang wanita cantik, kaya, namun dikhianati oleh suaminya yang suka berselingkuh. Ia kemudian dibantu oleh Ramin, seorang pengacara cerdas, untuk membalas dendam dan mengatur siasat, yang akhirnya menumbuhkan cinta di antara keduanya.

programme.title: Jampang 2
programme.desc: It is told that Jampang (Barry Prima), the son of Haji Raigun, is a betawi hero who always defends truth and justice against the Dutch invaders.

programme.title: Mega Bollywood: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: Sameer, yang cepat kehilangan kesabaran, dipindahkan ke Goa di mana dia jatuh cinta dengan Rani. Tapi teman sekamar Sameer yang baru, Sunny, punya rencana sendiri.

programme.title: Perkawinan Nyi Blorong
programme.desc: The film Perkawinan Nyi Blorong tells the story of two warlords fighting over Blorong's love. Dewata Cengkar beheads Tejo Arum in the battle for the right to marry the snake queen. The snake queen, who loves Tejo Arum, refuses to marry Dewata Cengkar.

programme.title: Jeritan Malam
programme.desc: Reza and his three friends tried to explore the history of the dorm they lived. But unfortunately, Reza does a ritual that should not have been done.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda yang bersemangat memulai perjalanan untuk memenuhi janji seorang ibu demi kehidupan yang lebih baik sambil mengatasi tantangan dan kehilangan.

programme.title: Black Cat 2
programme.desc: Scientists install a micro chip, called Black Cat, inside the brain of a violence prone girl in an attempt to refine and control her fits of rage. Their plan is to turn her into the perfect government secret agent killing machine.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Sayali, sosok perempuan muda pekerja keras yang memiliki impian besar untuk membahagiakan keluarganya dan meraih kehidupan yang lebih layak. Namun perjalanan hidupnya tidak mudah. Ia harus menghadapi berbagai persoalan mulai dari keterbatasan ekonomi hingga konflik keluarga yang terus menghampiri.

programme.title: Mercury Man
programme.desc: After a brush with a strange substance, an average fireman transforms into something far greater than himself--the Mercury Man. Endowed with fantastic superpowers, he will now use his abilities to help conquer the forces of evil.

programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: Rumitnya cinta, perbedaan kasta antara Angad Brar, dari keluarga kaya dan Sahiba Monga, gadis sederhana. Mereka terpaksa menikah demi menjaga kehormatan keluarga. Seerat, kakak Sahiba kabur dengan pria lain, Garry, saudara Angad, di hari pernikahan.

programme.title: Chak De! India
programme.desc: A 2007 Bollywood sports film about field hockey in India

programme.title: Sinema Laga Klasik: Rajawali dari Utara
programme.desc: Kisah Kidang Telangkas yang mengembara untuk mencari pembunuh istri dan anaknya oleh Ki Dapaksa. Dalam perjalannya Ia bertemu dengan Nawangsih yang kemudian ingin ikut bersamanya. Namun Nawangsih diserahkan kepada gurunya untuk dilatih silat.

programme.desc: The ANTV program “Hati Ke Hati Bersama Mamah Dedeh” is a well-known religious talk show, particularly among Muslim women in Indonesia. This religious program thoroughly explores family issues in everyday life, discussing them from an Islamic perspective.

The story centers on Sailee’s struggles as she faces resistance from her husband and her efforts to inspire change not only for their own growth but also for the well-being of their entire family.

programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: The fate of the three Brar cousins Angad, Garry and Veer are linked with the three Monga sisters Sahiba, Seerat and Keerat. Sahiba is the hardworking and independent second daughter of the Monga family. She is an artist and earns money for her family by selling her art. Seerat, the eldest Monga sister, is pampered by her mother, Santosh, for her beauty. Santosh dreams of getting Seerat married to a rich man. As fate would have it, Angad falls in love with Seerat. However, Seerat is manipulated by Garry and his fake love. On Seerat and Angad's wedding day, Seerat runs away with Garry.

programme.title: Malam Satu Syuro
programme.desc: Bayu brings Adinda to hospital to give birth. Bayu goes back home and when he returns to the hospital he finds an empty, vacant old building.

programme.title: Kain Kafan Hitam
programme.desc: Evelyn accidentally finds a black shroud inside an old closet in her family home. This shroud carries a mystery related to his family's past. Together with Bimo, Evelyn embarks on a journey to uncover the secrets behind the shroud.

programme.title: Sea Wolves
programme.desc: During World War II, British Intelligence brings a crew of ex-soldiers out of retirement, using their age as cover, to take to the seas and pull off an unlikely undercover mission in neutral Goa.

programme.title: Pisaj
programme.desc: After losing both her parents in a horrific tragedy, a young girl ends up with her aunt, a printing house owner and a part-time spiritual medium.

programme.title: Dear Zindagi
programme.desc: Kaira is a budding cinematographer in search of a perfect life. Her encounter with Jug, an unconventional thinker, helps her gain a new perspective on life. She discovers that happiness is all about finding comfort in life's imperfections.

programme.title: Hati Ke Hati Bersama Mamah...
programme.desc: The ANTV program “Hati Ke Hati Bersama Mamah Dedeh” is a well-known religious talk show, particularly among Muslim women in Indonesia. This religious program thoroughly explores family issues in everyday life, discussing them from an Islamic perspective.

programme.title: Aini: Malaikat Tak Bersayap
programme.desc: Aini, who disobeyed her mother and took the wrong path for wealth, was betrayed by someone she trusted and became blind. Unexpectedly, an angel named Zidan came as the embodiment of Aini's mother's sincere prayers to protect her.

programme.title: Antara Cinta Dan Dusta
programme.desc: Atikah is an innocent, funny, kind, sincere, patient, and hardworking girl. She lives with her grandmother, Mbah Marni, in the village of Wagir Kidul, near Ponorogo, East Java. There, there is a young doctor named Aryo who works as a PTT (non-permanent employee) at a community health center.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: The Flying Mr. B

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: Anita Yuan Yung-yi stars as an illegitimate daughter who inadvertently finds a pearl with a genie in it. Michael Wong is the genie who gives her three wishes, leading to a lot of hilarity and even a little heartbreak.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: A rich family's son falls in love with a woman who will only marry him once he becomes a Kung-Fu Master. In this 'Dramedy' He becomes a legendary hero, by attempting to save the emperor, during his true quest of love.

programme.title: Love In A Fallen City
programme.desc: A cynical playboy pursues an introverted divorcee in the decadence of Hong Kong on the eve of the 1941 Japanese invasion.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl. But Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world.

programme.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
programme.desc: A story of the illegal immigrant experience of people from the mainland of China who have made it to Hong Kong for a better life.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition, he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Best friends Bodil and Isabel, apparently happily married, sneak off for secret affairs using each other as an alibi. But when Isabel is killed when they were supposed to have been together. Bodil gets caught up in her own web of lies.

programme.title: She Is In Danger
programme.desc: Xue discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her. Can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung is a mischievous, yet righteous young man, but after a series of incidents, his frustrated father has him disciplined by a master of drunken martial arts.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in the past to kill the Dragon Master as she know that they were close friends back then.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: A rich old man and a sexy young photographer compete for a stunning young gym instructor. The younger man is clearly winning until the rich man offers a deal.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Valentino is a mediocre con artist who crosses paths with Kwan, a fellow con artist. Together, they impersonate various people and create numerous schemes to make money. Meanwhile, gangsters are making a scheme of their own.

programme.title: God Of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: Multi talented Cho wants to learn from the God of Gamblers and contacts his disciple. They are attacked by a crime boss with a plan to misuse GoG's good name to make millions.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters.

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: The Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Chow stars as Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Dipicu oleh kembalinya keyakinannya pada kemanusiaan dan terinspirasi oleh tindakan tanpa pamrih Superman, Bruce Wayne meminta bantuan sekutu barunya, Diana Prince, untuk menghadapi musuh yang lebih besar.

programme.title: The Little Things
programme.desc: Deputi Sheriff Joe Deacon dikirim ke Los Angeles untuk tugas yang seharusnya cepat. Namun, ia malah terlibat dalam pencarian pembunuh berantai yang meneror kota itu.

programme.title: The Little Things

programme.title: Abrakadabra

programme.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy & The Lemmings Merupakan Animasi Yang Menceritakan Tentang Seekor Beruang Grizzly Yang Bernama Grizzy Dan Sekawanan Leming Yang Selalu Ingin "Bermain" Dengan Grizzy Setiap Harinya Sehingga Banyak Cerita Dan Petualangan Yang Menarik Dari Mereka.

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: Sebuah Intro Baru Dibuat Untuk Musim Ini. Pertama, Voltaire Tiba Dan Menjatuhkan Brainy , Papa Smurf , Smurfette , Dan Handy Dari Layar. Ketiganya Menunggangi Punggungnya Saat Ia Melewati Penduduk Desa, Petani , Koki , Dan Hefty . Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Dan Brainy Jatuh Dari Voltaire, Yang Diberi Buah Beri Oleh Lily . Sementara Itu, Baby Dan Monkey Menunggangi Diaper Daddy Dengan Gembira. Kemudian, Adegan Beralih Ke Willow , Yang Sedang Melihat Ke Dalam Bola Kristalnya Dan Merasakan Kehadiran Dua Gadis Smurf , Bubble Dan Firefly , Yang Berada Di Gubuk Gargamel, Salah Satunya Bercahaya Dan Yang Lainnya Memiliki Kepang. Penyihir Jahat Itu Datang Untuk Mencoba Menangkapnya Bersama Azrael , Dwayne, Dan Rowena. Firefly Terjebak, Tetapi Secara Ajaib Berteleportasi Ke Tempat Aman Bersama Bubble. Wild Kemudian Digunakan Sebagai Transisi Ke Desa, Dan Layar Penutup Menampilkan Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Brainy, Jokey , Hefty, Clumsy Dan Dimwitty (Sebagai Anggota Pemadam Kebakaran), Blossom , Storm , Wild, Bubble Dan Firefly.

programme.title: Nailoong Vs Bombloong

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.desc: Jett Dan Teman-Temannya, Super Wings, Terus Menghadapi Tantangan Baru Di Setiap Pengiriman. Mereka Harus Bekerja Sama Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Dengan Menggunakan Keahlian Unik Mereka. Pada Musim Ini Jett Memiliki Perubahan Pada Tenaga Supernya Yaitu Menggunakan Mesin Listrik! Memiliki Desain Futuristic Dan Lebih Ramping Dari Sebelumnya, Mereka Dibuat Seperti Itu Agar Sesuai Dengan Konsep Listrik Baru Dan Mereka Juga Menyambut Energi Terbaru Yang Bersih Dan Ramah Lingkungan.

programme.title: Movinesia
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Yang Menghadirkan Sederet Film Pilihan Untuk Menemani Aktivitas Anda Dengan Dimeriahkan Oleh Para Pemain & Artis Papan Atas Berbakat, Dengan Cerita Ringan Seputar Kehidupan Remaja.

programme.title: Ustadz On The Road
programme.desc: Program Religi Yang Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Dan Ustadz Yang Akan Memberikan Kajian Islami Dengan Treatment On The Road Disertai Dengan Study Kasus. Pembahasan Dilakukan Sepanjang Perjalanan Menuju Lokasi Sesuai Agenda Harian Ustadz. Program Ini Akan Disajikan Secara Ringan Dan Menyenangkan.

programme.title: Marsupilami
programme.desc: Hector Ikut Dengan Tantenya, Diane, Untuk Menghabiskan Satu Tahun Di Hutan Agar Dia Dapat Mempelajari Flora Dan Fauna. Sebagai Seorang Anak Laki-Laki Yang Senang Akan Petualangan, Ia Berteman Baik Dengan Marsupilami Yang Legendaris. Hector Memiliki Keluarga Baru Yang Menyenangkan Dengan Hidup Di Antara Hewan - Hewan Tersebut. Suatu Hari, Kehidupan Barunya Yang Menyenangkan Di Hutan Tiba-Tiba Terancam Dengan Kedatangan Felicia Devort, Seorang Industrialis Megalomaniak Yang Ingin Merusak Hutan Untuk Membangun Kota Devort Di Lokasi Hutan Itu.

programme.title: Ibra Berkisah
programme.desc: Ibrahim Atau Ibra Adalah Murid Pesantren Yang Santun Dan Selalu Mengajak Teman-Temannya Untuk Meneladani Nabi Muhammad Saw, Dia Pun Sejak Kecil Sudah Tinggal Di Pesantren. Ibra Memiliki Teman Bernama Tokek Dan Hoho. Tokek Adalah Anak Yang Lucu Dan Periang, Sedangkan Hoho Adalah Seorang Anak Jakarta Yang Dilahirkan Dari Keluarga Kaya Raya, Sifatnya Manja Dan Tidak Mengerti Sama Sekali Tentang Islam. Selama Di Pesantren, Hoho Sekamar Dengan Ibra Yang Mana Di Perkenalan Awal Mereka, Hoho Menganggap Remeh Ibra Yang Dia Anggap Sebagai Anak Kampung. Tapi Ternyata Dari Ibra Lah Hoho Banyak Mendapatkan Pelajaran Hidup Dan Kisah-Kisah Teladan Nabi Muhammad Shalallahu Alaihi Wassalam.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Serial Reboot Atau Seri Baru Yang Diluncurkan Pada Tahun 2015 Di Inggris. Versi Ini Menghadirkan Kembali Karakter Ikonik Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa, Dan Po Di Teletubbyland Dengan Visual Yang Diperbarui, Menyapa Generasi Baru Penonton Prasekolah Dengan Nuansa Yang Lebih Modern.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy & The Lemmings Merupakan Animasi Yang Menceritakan Tentang Seekor Beruang Grizzly Yang Bernama Grizzy Dan Sekawanan Leming Yang Selalu Ingin "Bermain" Dengan Grizzy Setiap Harinya Sehingga Banyak Cerita Dan Petualangan Yang Menarik Dari Mereka.

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: Sebuah Intro Baru Dibuat Untuk Musim Ini. Pertama, Voltaire Tiba Dan Menjatuhkan Brainy , Papa Smurf , Smurfette , Dan Handy Dari Layar. Ketiganya Menunggangi Punggungnya Saat Ia Melewati Penduduk Desa, Petani , Koki , Dan Hefty . Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Dan Brainy Jatuh Dari Voltaire, Yang Diberi Buah Beri Oleh Lily . Sementara Itu, Baby Dan Monkey Menunggangi Diaper Daddy Dengan Gembira. Kemudian, Adegan Beralih Ke Willow , Yang Sedang Melihat Ke Dalam Bola Kristalnya Dan Merasakan Kehadiran Dua Gadis Smurf , Bubble Dan Firefly , Yang Berada Di Gubuk Gargamel, Salah Satunya Bercahaya Dan Yang Lainnya Memiliki Kepang. Penyihir Jahat Itu Datang Untuk Mencoba Menangkapnya Bersama Azrael , Dwayne, Dan Rowena. Firefly Terjebak, Tetapi Secara Ajaib Berteleportasi Ke Tempat Aman Bersama Bubble. Wild Kemudian Digunakan Sebagai Transisi Ke Desa, Dan Layar Penutup Menampilkan Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Brainy, Jokey , Hefty, Clumsy Dan Dimwitty (Sebagai Anggota Pemadam Kebakaran), Blossom , Storm , Wild, Bubble Dan Firefly.

programme.title: Blox Buster
programme.desc: Blox Buster Adalah Program Entertainment Yang Menghadirkan Keseruan Bermain Di Dunia Roblox, Platform Game Populer Dengan Jutaan Kreasi Dari Komunitas Global, Penonton Diajak Menjelajahi Berbagai Dunia Virtual Yang Penuh Warna, Menantang, Sekaligus Menyenangkan. Tidak Hanya Sekadar Bermain, Main Bareng Blox Juga Menyuguhkan Pengalaman Unik Dari Para Gamers Yang Ikut Serta, Mulai Dari Review Game, Tips Seru, Hingga Momen-Momen Kejutan Yang Terjadi Saat Bermain.

programme.title: Boboiboy
